88.
(1)  The  centralized  electronic  system  shall
automatically generate redacted version of every declaration
of  assets  and  liabilities  which  is  accessible  to  the  general
public  within  three  months  of  its  submission  through  the
official website of the Commission. Such redacted version
shall not include –

(a)
the address of the residence of the declarant or of
any other person, whose assets are declared by the
declarant;

(b)
full  address/es  of  declared  real  estate  except
information  pertaining  to  the  ward  and  district  in
which the real estate is situated;

(c)
date  of  birth,  National  Identity  Card  Number,
Passport Number or any other number recognized
by  the  relevant  authorities  for  the  purpose  of
identification  of  individuals  mentioned  in  the
declaration;  or
